body_you:
A moment of real growth can unexpectedly pull an old insecurity straight to the surface. When a big opportunity makes you second-guess yourself, the immediate reflex is to overcompensate. You might feel a sudden, intense pressure to say yes to everything and overcommit, just to prove you actually deserve the space you are taking up. The opportunity itself may be good. The problem starts when you turn it into proof that you can handle more, carry more, or ask less in return. You do not have to make an opportunity harder on yourself to feel like you earned it.

With Chiron {{aspectWord}} your Jupiter until {{untilDate}}, you can step fully into this expansion without letting insecurity push you into a massive obligation you will just have to back out of later.
